title: Fix client-verification broken by server content transformation
description: §2 (line 131-134) says server MUST compute sha256 from stored bytes if it transforms content. §2.1 (line 148-152) says clients SHOULD compare server-returned sha256 against digest of *sent* bytes. If server transforms content, these will never match — client always sees a mismatch and SHOULD NOT use the blobId. This is a legal server behavior breaking a correct client. Options: (1) add a signal for server transformation so clients know to skip verification, (2) return both received-bytes and stored-bytes digests, or (3) forbid server content transformation when capability is active.
